stem: What is the clinical definition of chronic pain in the pediatric population as mentioned in the material?

options.text: Pain that persists for more than 1 month after an injury.
Pain lasting 3 months or more beyond the usual expected healing time.
Pain that occurs daily for at least 2 weeks.
Any pain associated with hypermobility or regional syndromes.

explanation: Chronic pain is time-based and defined as persisting for around 3 months or more after the initial illness or injury.
rationale: Think about the standard quarterly timeframe used to distinguish acute from persistent pain.

optionExplanations.A: While 1 month is a significant duration, the specific clinical threshold cited for chronic pain is longer.
optionExplanations.B: Chronic pain is time-based and defined as persisting for around 3 months or more after the initial illness or injury.
optionExplanations.C: This duration is too short to meet the formal clinical definition of chronic pain provided in the text.
optionExplanations.D: These are examples of conditions that can cause chronic pain, but the definition itself is based on time duration.

originalCorrectOptionTexts: Pain lasting 3 months or more beyond the usual expected healing time.
